marks.gloss_en: לימא מסייע ליה: R' Yosei b. R' Chanina bathed in cold all seven days
אמרי: התם בשתכפוהו אבליו זה אחר זה, דתניא... (= p_stam_tchafuhu_avelav)
לימא מסייע ליה: the bogeret... הא נערה רשאה; hot? but Rav Chisda: not a finger in hot! so cold
לא, אכיחול ופירכוס (= p_stam_kichul_ufirkus)
זאת אומרת -- since laundering in water is allowed only when his mournings came one after another, otherwise a mourner may not launder (dika_nami: chullin_87a precedent for זאת אומרת)
והלכתא: whole body, hot and cold, forbidden all seven
face, hands, feet: cold permitted
smearing, any amount, forbidden
smearing to remove dirt permitted
Rav Chisda: this is to say, a mourner is forbidden to launder all seven days
וכי יחיד קובע ברכה לעצמו? אלא בשומע תפלה
in [the blessing] 'who hears prayer'

מיתיבי: a grown woman may not make herself unattractive -- הא נערה רשאה. מאי לאו ברחיצה? hot? but Rav Chisda: not a finger in hot! so cold -- and the young girl may refrain even from cold, i.e. a mourner is forbidden cold
the baraita: a grown woman may not make herself unattractive in the days of mourning for her father (inferred by the stam: a young girl may)
לא, אכיחול ופירכוס (= p_stam_kichul_ufirkus)
the stam: no -- [the baraita speaks of] painting the eyes and arranging the hair
מאי שנא מבשר ויין? -- a mourner may have meat and wine
התם לפכוחי פחדיה הוא דעביד (= p_stam_lefakuchei_pachdei)
Rava (second version): a mourner is forbidden [to bathe] in cold water all seven days
מיתיבי: אין בין יחיד לציבור אלא י"ח / י"ט. Not the prayer leader -- he prays 24! so: an individual in an individual fast vs an individual in a public fast. שמע מינה יחיד קובע ברכה לעצמו (13b.11)
the baraita: the only difference between an individual and a community is that this one prays eighteen and that one nineteen
לא, לעולם שליח צבור, in the first three fasts, which have no twenty-four (= p_stam_rishonot_lo_esrim_vearba; its own attack and defence are obj_ein_bein_rishonot_emtzaiyot)
the stam: no -- 'community' is the prayer leader, and [the baraita speaks] of the first three fasts, in which there are not twenty-four
ולא? והא אין בין קתני: first three vs middle three differ only in work -- so for the twenty-four they are the same
the baraita: the only difference between the first three and the middle three is that on these work is permitted and on those forbidden
after תנא ושייר is rejected (מאי שייר דהאי שייר? ותו: והא אין בין קתני): אלא תנא באיסורי קא מיירי, בתפלות לא מיירי
ואי בעית אימא: באמצעייתא נמי לא מצלי עשרים וארבע (= p_stam_emtzaiyot_lo_esrim_vearba; attacked at 13b.15)
the stam, alternatively: on the middle ones too they do not pray twenty-four

ולא?! והתניא: second three vs last seven differ only in the alarm and the shops -- so in all else the same; and תנא ושייר is barred, אין בין קתני. (13b.16-14a.1 ותסברא אין בין דוקא? והא שייר תיבה -- answered: the ark is public and not taught, so no omission; that round fortifies this attack.)
the baraita: the only difference between the second three and the last seven is that on these they sound the alarm and lock the shops
Rav Yehuda (expounded by Rav Yitzchak): an individual who accepted a fast upon himself prays the prayer of a fast
